sources.title: Microsoft Word report templates — Business report (graphic design)
sources.evidence: Official page describes consistent headings, appendix sections and an easy-to-scan layout. Business report (graphic design) has blue/modern/simple catalogue labels. Fonts, colors and headings are customizable. Free/customizable use does not establish plugin redistribution permission; none was verified.
sources.usedFor: Original formal work report: substantive summary, evidence, actions, responsibilities and recommendations with semantic headings. Chinese SimSun justified typography is an independent office convention, not copied Microsoft styling. Reference links only; no source template/assets copied. Original recipe and native examples are MIT.
sources.atlasUse: Reference for Word element structure or styling; original native atlas only, no third-party template binaries/assets.

sources.title: GOV.UK — Publishing accessible documents
sources.evidence: Footer: All content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0, except where otherwise stated. Guidance specifies sans serif text of at least 12 points, left alignment, a single continuous column, semantic headings and simple data tables. OGL permits copying, distribution, adaptation and commercial use with attribution and exemptions. License verified at https://www.nationalarchives.gov.uk/doc/open-government-licence/version/3/.
sources.usedFor: Semantic heading hierarchy, logical structure and no color-only meaning inform the original business approval request. GOV.UK recommends sans-serif/left-aligned text; it does not recommend our Chinese SimSun justified typography, which is independently chosen. No government branding or assets copied. OGL text retains attribution and terms.
sources.atlasUse: Reference for Word element structure or styling; original native atlas only, no third-party template binaries/assets.

sources.title: Microsoft Excel budget templates — Basic personal budget
sources.evidence: Official page describes tracking expenses, planning monthly spending, replacing cell values/names and customizing colors. Basic personal budget and Basic monthly budget have green/modern/simple catalogue labels. No plugin redistribution permission was verified; free customizable use is not an open redistribution license.
sources.usedFor: Original monthly budget execution: budget/actual/difference structure, categorized detail, reproducible KPI formulas and explicit period/currency assumptions. Original three-sheet workbook and native chart; no Microsoft workbook, formulas or assets copied. MIT applies only to original implementation.
sources.atlasUse: Reference for Excel element structure or styling; original native atlas only, no third-party template binaries/assets.

sources.title: Government Analysis Function — Releasing statistics in spreadsheets
sources.evidence: Guidance recommends named structured tables, one header row, no merged/split/nested cells, visible wrapped text, consistent precision and right-aligned figures. https://analysisfunction.civilservice.gov.uk/terms-of-use/ states most content is Crown copyright under OGL, with AF attribution and titles/credits/URLs retained. Terms expressly restrict site images outside their intended use. Example spreadsheet internals were not inspected.
sources.usedFor: Original project execution tracking: descriptive headings, named native Tables, consistent number formats and separate issue/assumption records. Dashboard KPIs and native chart use original formulas and source-worksheet references. No AF images or example workbooks copied. OGL text retains attribution and terms; publication-specific advice is not universal.
sources.atlasUse: Reference for Excel element structure or styling; original native atlas only, no third-party template binaries/assets.

sources.title: Microsoft PowerPoint presentation templates — Scientific discovery
sources.evidence: Official page describes highly customizable layouts for work or school and customization of colors, logos and fonts. Scientific discovery has blue/modern/simple catalogue labels. No plugin redistribution permission for the deck, masters or assets was verified.
sources.usedFor: General reference for adaptable layout families and consistent hierarchy. The original eight-page operating review uses reconciled business data, editable quantitative geometry/tables and restrained warm ivory/charcoal/copper styling; no source artwork, master or template reproduced. MIT covers original content only.
sources.atlasUse: Reference for PowerPoint element structure or styling; original native atlas only, no third-party template binaries/assets.

sources.title: LibreOffice Extensions — Modern template
sources.evidence: Official extension page describes Impress templates in various color combinations; Green, Orange and Blue release rows each list CC0. https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en permits copying, modification and distribution including commercially, without permission, but does not clear trademarks or third-party rights. Website default CC BY-SA 3.0 for text/images is distinct from release CC0. OTP internals, fonts and PPTX compatibility were not audited.
sources.usedFor: Reference for a consistent layout family and geometric structure. The original eight-page project proposal uses editable workflow, ROI scenarios, risk/resource matrices and cool white/ink/mist-blue styling. Link reference only; no OTP, font, screenshot or other source asset bundled. Release CC0 does not relicense website images or remove future internal asset audits.
sources.atlasUse: Reference for PowerPoint element structure or styling; original native atlas only, no third-party template binaries/assets.

sources.title: Vertex42 — Business Budget Template
sources.evidence: HTTP 200 retrieved 2026-10-13. These are not general plugin redistribution rights.
sources.usedFor: Reference for budget versus actual differences, categorized costs and independent total reconciliation. Only page text and publicly displayed examples are reviewed; no Vertex42 workbook, image, formula or derived template is distributed. Our workbook and formulas are original.
